local-3-node.topology: one localhost gateway plus two localhost peers
notes: Publisher and subscriber WebSocket clients both attach to the publisher peer.
The three-node mesh is still formed and the contract is retained there; notify uses the local executor channel.
Freenet 0.2.112 UPDATE requires ContractKey.code to carry WASM bytes (stdlib double-hash bug); FreenetClient prefers fallbackCodeField WASM first.
Cross-node notify is recorded separately under local-cross-node.

local-cross-node.topology: one localhost gateway plus two localhost peers; publisher and subscriber clients on distinct Freenet WebSocket endpoints
notes: FREENET_FORCE_CROSS_NODE=1 with a 50 ms inter-sample gap; without pacing, Freenet 0.2.112 drops subscription snapshots under a sustained update blast.
All 300 deliveries arrived as WebSocket notifies (0 GET reconciles) on this reviewed run.
measure-roundtrip allows GET reconciliation on cross-node runs when notifies are missing (B2 hint model); this series did not need it.
1 MiB cross-node p95 is ~2.5 s — viable for occasional large state, not a high-rate packet path.

live.remaining: requires explicit authorization before any live-network contract update

viability.role2PacketTunnel: viable-on-local-executor-path; cross-node notify viable for <=64 KiB with pacing
viability.summary: Local-executor p95 update-to-notify is under 90 ms for 1 KiB and 64 KiB and under 260 ms for 1 MiB. Cross-node notify (distinct Freenet WebSockets, paced) p95 is under 120 ms for <=64 KiB and ~2.5 s for 1 MiB. Live-network confirmation remains open.
